title: How it unfolded: 2024 to 22 October
subtitle: Five moments, from an audit nobody acted on to sites going dark. 9 panels.
rule: Every line a character says is the storyboard's own words, not a quote, and is marked not_a_quote; every evidence panel quotes this site's data word for word and names the file (quote_from), which the gate checks; every panel cites the evidence vault's source slugs it rests on (cites), which the gate checks against the manifest.

scenes.title: How it unfolded
scenes.subtitle: 2024 to 22 October 2026, in five moments
scenes.note: Who this is for: anyone asking how a bug from 2024 became a headline in October 2026.

scenes.caption: Five moments
scenes.note: The five moments on the front page, each linked to its page on this site.

scenes.caption: 2024: noticed, and left

evidence.quote: An audit spots the out-of-memory weakness. Nobody can show it is exploitable, so it is left.

scenes.note: The PHP Foundation's account of the 2024 audit.

scenes.caption: August 2026: three teams, with AI

cast.says: Three teams. Working attacks within three weeks.

scenes.note: The GitHub advisories credit four reporters, among them Calif, Wiz and OpenAI; Calif reported first, on 11 August.

scenes.caption: 20 October: the leak

evidence.quote: The secret leaks: the CVE numbers circulate two days early, with a wrong severity score.

scenes.note: Who leaked it, and where, is still not known.

scenes.caption: 21 October: a day early
scenes.note: PHP releases the fix a day ahead of plan; Cloudflare had rules live about nine hours before disclosure by its own account.

scenes.caption: 22 October: sites go dark
scenes.note: The NSA and CISA said take systems offline if you cannot update; Dutch government services such as DigiD were taken offline.

scenes.caption: The first official words

evidence.quote: If an immediate update is not feasible, it is recommend[ed] that organizations take the system offline until it can be fully mitigated.
evidence.source: NSA Cybersecurity on X, 21 October, 13:45 UTC (data/agencies.json)

scenes.note: Posted before the CVE records were published.

scenes.punchline: Found in 2024. Proved in August. Fixed in a day.
scenes.note: Every dated event is on /timeline/ with its sources.
